thread:
maya: quick thread — final acceptance playbook for GA, focused on weird edge cases and escalation paths. want to lock owners by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: thanks — can you list the top ‘odd’ scenarios you want covered?

maya: good call. initial list: 1) model fallback loop (infinite retries), 2) partial KV-cache corruption on hosts, 3) KMS key rotation hiccup causing private deploy auth failures, 4) billing meter misattribution for embeddings requests, 5) regional burst fallback that routes to higher-cost model unexpectedly.

sarah: add: canary traffic flip that leaves a small % on old model due to sticky sessions, and worker OOM patterns that only appear under 2x burst.

luca: support implications: customers will expect a timeline and remediation steps. we should pre-author a tenant-visible status template for each scenario.

priya: on billing misattribution — we need a runnable query and a CSV-level reconciliation step we can hand to finance. also SLA credit calc examples.

eric: docs note — we need: quick troubleshooting bullet list, runbook links, sample curl repros, and a customer-facing FAQ entry per case.

maya: agreed. proposal: for each edge case create: 1) triage checklist (what to check first), 2) automated smoke test, 3) rollback/fallback policy, 4) public/status message template, 5) owner & pager.

devon: i sketched a minimal triage checklist for model fallback loop:```
- check routing policy logs (/var/log/router/route.log) for repeated 5xx
- inspect model variant compatibility map (service-config)
- verify prefix cache TTLs and kv-cache integrity via tool: /opt/rw/kvcheck --scan
- if loop confirmed: flip routing to safe-fallback (route: model-lite-v1) and notify oncall
```

sarah: love the checklist. smoke test suggestion: scripted sequence that sends a mix of short and long prompts and asserts no >3 successive retries and latency < 300ms p50. store a baseline.

maya: who owns the automated smoke test?

devon: runtime team will implement — owner: devon. ETA: 2 days to have PR + ci job.

luca: i'll draft the customer status messages. owner: luca. template example: "We are investigating an inference routing issue affecting a subset of requests. Mitigation: routing has been set to a safe fallback model while we diagnose. ETA for next update: 30m."

priya: for billing issue i'll provide a reconciler query and failure-mode examples. owner: priya. also need a billing impact classification table: 
```
P0: charges misapplied across accounts (> $50k impact)
P1: incorrect embedding unit attribution for single tenant (> $1k)
P2: minor rounding errors
```

eric: docs owner for runbooks: eric — i'll assemble short and long versions. short = 1 page; long = step-by-step with logs and diagnostic commands.

jen: legal note: any public messaging about "billing errors" needs pre-approved wording. i'll review templates today. owner: jen.

maya: escalation paths: primary oncall -> secondary oncall -> eng-runtime oncall -> eng-sre lead -> product director. each transition should include a >2 minute handoff note and current mitigations.

sarah: add SLA decision flow: if >5% error rate sustained >10m -> trigger 15 min incident call and auto-notify affected customers via status. if >95th percentile latency crosses SLA for 3 consecutive 5-min buckets -> auto-failover to dedicated pool if configured.

devon: technical runbook needs the exact commands to trigger the dedicated pool failover (and the safety checks). i'll paste a minimal snippet into the runbook PR.

deploy-bot: deploy started by devon at 2976543350 — runtime/fallback-checks branch -> staging.

luca: operational note: for private deployments we need a separate runbook that excludes status page updates (customer owns status) but includes customer notification text and KMS rotation contact flow. owner: luca + support-ops.

maya: acceptance criteria for GA (proposed, must be testable):
- SLA matrix documented and signed off (latency, availability, error budgets)
- Runbooks for the 7 listed edge cases exist and link to automated smoke tests
- Smoke tests green in CI for 48h and scheduled daily for 30 days post-GA
- Billing reconciliation script + sample outputs validated on a non-prod dataset
- Public messaging templates approved by legal + comms
- Oncall escalation path documented and rehearsed in a tabletop for 2 scenarios
- Pricing tier behavior for fallback routes documented and confirmed by finops

priya: i can validate pricing tier behavior with a simulated routing matrix. need a test customer that spans free/tier1/tier2.

eric: docs ETA: draft runbooks by EOD tomorrow, public FAQ by noon Friday.

devon: runtime PR linked, will add failover commands and smoke test. ETA: tomorrow morning.

sarah: i'll schedule the tabletop with oncall for Friday 11am.

maya: ok — owners: devon(smoke+runtime), eric(runbooks/docs), luca(status+private runbooks), priya(billing/pricing sims), jen(legal), sarah(oncall/tabletop). i'll compile a short acceptance tracker after this thread. if no objections i'll mark this as the launch acceptance playbook baseline. :white_check_mark:

luca: no objections from support.

jen: quick note — legal will need the final public message at least 2h before release window to approve.

maya: noted. final acceptance tracker will include that deadline. thanks everyone — i'll post the tracker and owners doc in the release folder in ~30m.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded at 2976543465

maya: perfect. closing the thread, will follow up with the tracker."
